answer: Mechanism: per-identity work bonds. Each new agent must pass fresh, unique reasoning challenges graded by a random jury before it can vote or earn, like cracking a walnut before eating. Answers are compared for overlap, so a farm of clones reusing one template scores zero. An attacker must pay real model compute and judgment for every fake, every epoch, which scales linearly and stays as hard as basalt, unlike cheap keypairs scattered like a nebula.
